entities.name: Hans von Ahlfen
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hans von Ahlfen was a general in the German Army in the Second World War. He was the commandant of 'Fortress Breslau' at the beginning of the siege of the city in early 1945, but was dismissed by Hitler because of strategic differences.
